summary.text: Oscar Rosa is the Republican candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 35, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democratic incumbent Oscar Longoria.
Rosa also ran against Longoria in the 2022 general election, which Longoria won with 64.2 percent of the vote to Rosa's 35.8 percent.

paragraphs.text: Oscar Rosa advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
He was the Republican nominee for the same District 35 seat in 2022, when he received 8,690 votes to Longoria's 15,569.
